Name: Demetrius Narrative Overhaul
Author: haywrites
Description:
[color=#6aa84f]Demetrius[/color], the Pelican Town scientist, was in a bit of a pickle. He only spoke in technobabble, and never brought up his stepson, Sebastian.
Now, through the magic of modding, he has become his own person!

The [color=#dd7e6b][color=#6aa84f]Demetrius[/color] [/color]Narrative Overhaul takes Demetrius, the Botanist of Pelican Town, and gives him a much needed fleshing out.
Now, Demetrius struggles with being a good father, clashes with Sebastian, shares his love of Maru and Robin, gets to know you, and beyond!.

[color=#00ff00][size=5][b][size=4]Adding in over 190+ lines of unique dialogue! That's new lines for every day, season, and heart level![/size]
[/b][/size][/color]
There's also alternate lines for if you married his Maru or Sebastian!

I've applied my narrative design philosophy to make becoming friends with [color=#6aa84f]Demetrius[/color] a worthwhile experience. He is not romance-able, however, as he's already married!

[font=Verdana][size=4]1.3 And Beyond
With 1.3, the way .xnb files are found has been changed! In order to use my mods, you must
use the versatile and friendly Content Patcher.

How to install Content Patcher and the Mods:
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Download Content Patcher[/url]﻿

[*]Unzip the contents of Content Patcher into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Install any content packs (Narrative Overhauls) you want by unzipping them into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
A bit more complicated versus what it was before, but at least it will be possible!
For the Content Patcher version of this mod, download the 1.3 Multiplayer Patch Version of this mod!

(The latest versions of the mod files, uploaded 6/6/18, are the official versions, with the most up to date patches.)

PRE 1.3:
(THE BELOW WILL NOT WORK IF YOU HAVE THE MOST UP TO DATE VERSION OF STARDEW
VALLEY. See the "1.3 and Beyond" section above if you have the most
recent patch (1.3 Multiplayer)[/size][/font]

[u]How to install:[/u]
Incredibly simple:
1. Download and Unzip the XNB file.
2. Go to where you installed Stardew Valley.
3. Go to Stardew Valley\Content\Characters\Dialogue
4. Move the XNB file over and overwrite the old one.
5. You're done!

This mod is [color=#00ff00]Rated E,[/color] and uses no Gender Pronouns for your player character.

[color=#fff2cc][size=5]Version 1.1 Now Available![/size][/color][color=#fff2cc]
[size=4]Patch Notes:
-Fixed a LOT of spelling errors. Whoops! My new pipeline works pretty well now, though!
-The infamous Vegetable error has been fixed. Whoops!
-Added unique ending sayings for each day of the week, including unique ones for each day at the 10th heart level.
-Changed a few lines that didn't read quite right.[/size][/color]

[color=#ead1dc][size=4][b]Perfect 10 Edition Extra File:[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#ead1dc][color=#ff0000]❤[/color]For people who got Demetrius' Heart Level to 10![color=#ff0000]❤[/color][/color]
A best of mix of all the dialogue from this mod for every day of every season. This is for people who have had Demetrius at heart level 10 for awhile, or got tired of what he says at level 10 with the N.O.

With this, you'll see dialogue you may have missed, and he'll have something different to say the whole year long!

The install instructions are the same as above, however, the perfect 10 edition overwrites the previous mod! Which is okay if he's at Heart Level 10.
